realm_description: The coastline where continents first meet the wider world. Every citizen's story starts here, pulled outward by trade, curiosity, and the promise of connection.

primary.label: Scout
primary.description: Goes first into the unknown and turns fear of it into momentum.
primary.guiding_promise: I go first — so others know the way is possible.
primary.shadow_description: Leaps first so often they stop checking whether anyone can actually follow.

secondary.label: Reformer
secondary.description: Driven by justice, dreads stagnation more than backlash.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will not accept a broken world when a better one is possible.
secondary.shadow_description: Burns down what was merely imperfect, mistaking any resistance for the enemy.

wheel.central_question: Should we wait for wisdom to settle, or act before understanding is complete?

growth.label: Reformer
growth.description: Driven by justice, dreads stagnation more than backlash.
growth.guiding_promise: I will not accept a broken world when a better one is possible.
growth.shadow_description: Burns down what was merely imperfect, mistaking any resistance for the enemy.

other_ally.label: Aristocrat
other_ally.description: Leads with inherited certainty and intuitive command.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I carry the weight of legacy and lead with the confidence it bestows.
other_ally.shadow_description: Mistakes inherited certainty for earned worth, and dismisses anyone without the pedigree to match.

quarter.label: Pathfinder
quarter.description: Pioneers toward new worlds; rejects comfort as a destination.
quarter.guiding_promise: I reject comfort as a destination — the frontier is where I belong.
quarter.shadow_description: Pushes so far past the frontier that no one is left who remembers why they went.

opposite.label: Sage
opposite.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
opposite.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

realmmate.label: Diplomat
realmmate.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
realmmate.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

wheel.compatible_text: Diplomat · Messenger — fellow travelers of The Shoreline.
